protocol.monotonicity_criterion: at fixed current and rest state, first-spike tick is nondecreasing in threshold offset over the full configured domain; otherwise replay every recruited cohort mapping

pyramidal_domain.coverage_rule: per-seed global-worst threshold assignment over all configured IDs; replay every recruited mapping if monotonicity is not proved

protocol.rank_assignment: rank 0 receives the maximum threshold; rank 1 receives the minimum; remaining descending currents map to ascending thresholds
protocol.relay_claim: orchestrated source-then-relay latency ordering, not synaptic causality
protocol.same_tick_tie_break: descending voltage-minus-threshold margin, then ascending physical GID
